description:
If goods shall be shipped, the secretary clarifies who will do the shipping. 
If you have large amounts, special shipping will be necessary. 
In these cases the secretary invites three logistic companies to make offers and she selects one of them. 
In case of small amounts, normal post shipment is used. 
Therefore a package label is written by the secretary and a parcel insurance taken by the logistics department head if necessary. 
In the meantime the goods can be already packaged by the warehousemen. 
If everything is ready, the packaged goods are prepared for being picked up by the logistic company.

                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/shipping">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShippingInvitation" name="Request for shipping offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ShippingOffer" name="Shipping offer"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Shipping" name="Ship goods" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AmountSplit" name="Choose shipping by amount"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InviteCompanies" name="Invite three logistic companies to make offers" messageRef="Message_ShippingInvitation"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OffersSplit" name="Wait for offers"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffer1" name="Receive offer from logistic company 1" messageRef="Message_ShippingOffer"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffer2" name="Receive offer from logistic company 2" messageRef="Message_ShippingOffer"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffer3" name="Receive offer from logistic company 3" messageRef="Message_ShippingOffer"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OffersJoin" name="Offers received"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectOffer" name="Secretary selects one offer"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeInsurance" name="Logistics department head takes parcel insurance"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PreparePickup" name="Prepare packaged goods for pickup by the logistic company"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_ShippingRequired" targetRef="Task_ClarifyShipping"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_ClarifyShipping" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_PackageGoods"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_PackageGoods" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AmountSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountSplit" targetRef="Task_InviteCompanies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">largeAmount</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountSplit" targetRef="Task_NormalPost">

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Gateway_OffersSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_OffersSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_OffersSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_OffersSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer3"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer1" targetRef="Gateway_OffersJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer2" targetRef="Gateway_OffersJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer3" targetRef="Gateway_OffersJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_OffersJoin" targetRef="Task_SelectOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_SelectOffer" targetRef="Gateway_AmountMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_NormalPost" targetRef="Gateway_AmountMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_AmountMerge" targetRef="Task_WriteLabel"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_WriteLabel" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceSplit" targetRef="Task_TakeInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">insuranceNecessary</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceSplit" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not insuranceNecessary</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_TakeInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Gateway_InsuranceMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_PreparePickup"/>

  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Shipping">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ShippingProcess" name="Shipping process" processRef="Process_Shipping"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LogisticsCompany1" name="Logistic company 1"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LogisticsCompany2" name="Logistic company 2"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LogisticsCompany3" name="Logistic company 3"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invite1" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Participant_LogisticsCompany1" messageRef="Message_ShippingInvitation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invite2" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Participant_LogisticsCompany2" messageRef="Message_ShippingInvitation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invite3" sourceRef="Task_InviteCompanies" targetRef="Participant_LogisticsCompany3" messageRef="Message_ShippingInvitation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer1" sourceRef="Participant_LogisticsCompany1" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer1" messageRef="Message_ShippingOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer2" sourceRef="Participant_LogisticsCompany2" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer2" messageRef="Message_ShippingOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer3" sourceRef="Participant_LogisticsCompany3" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer3" messageRef="Message_ShippingOffer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
